newsitem.title: USA: Loral to make $400 mln private offer.
newsitem.headline: Loral to make $400 mln private offer.

text.p: Loral Space & Communications Ltd said Thursday it plans to privately offer $400 million of Convertible Preferred Equivalent Obligations due 2006 and to grant to the initial purchasers an option to purchase an additional $80.0 million of Convertible Preferred Equivalent Obligations to cover over-allotments.
Loral said it intends to use the proceeds from the sale for general corporate purposes, which may include investments in SKYNET, Globalstar and other satellite communications opportunities.
